contract:
Contract CoCoMESystem::openCashDesk(cashDeskID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		selectedCashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstances()->any(cashDesk: CashDesk|cashDesk.Id = cashDeskID)
	precondition:
		self.CurrentStore.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentStore.IsOpened = true and
		CashDesk.allInstances()->exists(cashDesk: CashDesk|cashDesk.Id = cashDeskID and
		cashDesk.IsOpened = false)
	postcondition:
		selectedCashDesk.IsOpened = true and
		self.CurrentCashDesk = selectedCashDesk and
		result = true
}
